summary: Only teams and users from the synced organization can be selected. Grant catalog.entity.read and all scaffolder permissions (template.parameter.read, template.step.read, action.execute, task.cancel, task.create, task.read; task.read is needed for the History page), then create the role.
questions: Which permissions do portal users need to run templates?
Users cannot see History in the portal
What scaffolder permissions should I grant?

answer_card.title: Portal role for running job templates
answer_card.answer_md:
Administration > **RBAC > Create**, name (e.g. `portal-users`), add AAP teams/users from the synced org, then permissions:

- **Catalog**: `catalog.entity.read`
- **Scaffolder**: `scaffolder.template.parameter.read`, `scaffolder.template.step.read`, `scaffolder.action.execute`, `scaffolder.task.cancel`, `scaffolder.task.create`, `scaffolder.task.read`

`scaffolder.task.read` is required for the **History** page. Users still need **Execute** on the job template in AAP.
